title: Evaluating and Mitigating Bias in Image Classifiers: A Causal Perspective Using Counterfactuals
reasoning: The paper's core contribution is a method for evaluating and mitigating bias and ensuring fairness in AI image classifiers. These concepts, particularly bias against demographic groups and the notion of counterfactual fairness, are central topics in AI ethics. The entire motivation and application of the proposed technique are to address these ethical challenges, making it a primary component of the work.
